title: Developer publishing center
subtitle: Prepare a release, build a frozen package, and inspect its result.
operationFailed: The operation could not be completed
failureRecovery: Refresh to check the current result before repeating a write operation.
connectDescription: Start the publishing tool for this source workspace, then connect to view plans and tasks.

workflow.frozenPackage: The ZIP is saved with the code captured during the build.
workflow.uploadReceived: The market received the package. You can now prepare the publication details.
workflow.marketRequired: Add a market connection to set up upload access.
workflow.marketTokenRequired: Bind a publishing token with upload access for this plugin.
workflow.marketAuthorizationRequired: Verify upload access and capabilities for this market.
workflow.frozenChoice: This package contains the code from the previous build.
workflow.unfinishedChoice: Check build progress or prepare the build for this release.
workflow.versionHelp: You choose the version of the new package.
workflow.toolUpdateHelp: Reconnect the publishing tools to check the build environment and continue.

versionsDescription: Plans stay in this workspace. Creating a plan does not create a marketplace draft.
createDescription: The new package will use the version you enter.
noPlans: No release plans yet. Connect the executor and create your first plan.
buildDescription: Build the selected release once, then verify the same ZIP bytes.
platformUnavailable: The build tool did not report support for Linux / amd64. Check the environment again.
selectPlanFirst: Select or create a release plan first.
verified: The frozen package passed integrity and package admission checks.
pollPaused: Automatic task checks have paused. Resume checks or refresh to inspect this same task.
uploadDescription: Marketplace authorization and file upload are not connected yet. No upload or review request will be sent.
localArtifactAvailable: A local package for {version} is available.
connectionDescription: Marketplace connections and scoped publisher authorization will be available after market integration.
credentialsBoundary: Publisher tokens will be managed by the executor. This page does not accept or store them.
detailDescription: Inspect details for the current release and task.
setupDescription: Start the tool from a trusted source workspace. It creates a private bootstrap file for the development proxy.
setupEnvironment: Before starting Nuxt, set server-only POWERX_PUBLISHER_ORIGIN to the exact page origin and POWERX_PUBLISHER_SESSION_FILE to the absolute private tool-session.json path. Never use public runtime configuration for this file.

validation.version: Use a stable semantic version without a v prefix or prerelease suffix, at most 50 characters.
validation.notes: Release notes must not exceed 10000 UTF-8 bytes.

errors.PUBLISHER_INVALID_INPUT: Invalid publishing input; check the field or command parameters.
errors.PUBLISHER_INVALID_WORKSPACE: The workspace does not contain a valid plugin manifest.
errors.PUBLISHER_WORKSPACE_CHANGED: The workspace identity or source version changed; reopen the publishing tool.
errors.PUBLISHER_INVALID_RECORD: A local publishing record is invalid; inspect the stored record before continuing.
errors.PUBLISHER_STORAGE_FAILURE: Local publishing storage or service startup failed; check permissions and workspace state.
errors.PUBLISHER_NOT_FOUND: The requested local publishing resource was not found.
errors.PUBLISHER_CONFLICT: The local executor is already running or the record already exists.
errors.PUBLISHER_UNAUTHORIZED: The publishing tool session has expired. Reconnect to continue with the saved tasks and operations.
errors.PUBLISHER_FORBIDDEN: The request host or origin is not allowed.
errors.PUBLISHER_UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM: Local publishing storage is currently supported on Linux and macOS.
errors.PUBLISHER_REQUEST_TOO_LARGE: The local publishing request exceeds the size limit.
errors.PUBLISHER_MEDIA_TYPE_REQUIRED: The local request must use application/json.
errors.PUBLISHER_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: This operation does not accept the requested HTTP method.
errors.PUBLISHER_BUILD_PLATFORM_REQUIRED: Build directly from an Apple silicon Mac or Linux / amd64 with matching Go and Node.js tools.
errors.PUBLISHER_BUILD_BUSY: Another build owns this workspace; wait for it to finish or cancel it through its owner.
errors.PUBLISHER_BUILD_FAILED: The isolated build failed; inspect its redacted diagnostics and task stage.
errors.PUBLISHER_BUILD_SOURCE_CHANGED: Build inputs changed during the task; create a new build from the intended source.
errors.PUBLISHER_BUILD_SOURCE_UNSAFE: The build input, path, dependency or snapshot does not meet the isolated build contract.
errors.PUBLISHER_ARTIFACT_INVALID: The package identity, target, runtime, version or referenced resource failed validation.
errors.PUBLISHER_ARTIFACT_CHANGED: The frozen artifact is missing or its bytes no longer match the recorded digest.
errors.PUBLISHER_NATIVE_RUNTIME_UNVERIFIED: This profile requires a CGO-free Go backend and pure JavaScript frontend; native runtime files are blocked.
errors.PUBLISHER_BUILD_CANCELLED: The build was cancelled or reached its time budget.
errors.PUBLISHER_PROXY_NOT_CONFIGURED: Configure the private development proxy and restart Nuxt before connecting.
errors.PUBLISHER_PROXY_UNAVAILABLE: The local executor is unavailable. Check that it is running, then reconnect explicitly.
errors.PUBLISHER_PROXY_RESPONSE_INVALID: The executor returned an invalid response. Keep this task and inspect its result before continuing.
errors.PUBLISHER_MARKET_UNAVAILABLE: Market connection interrupted. Reconcile the original operation.
errors.PUBLISHER_MARKET_PROTOCOL: The market response failed rc.2 contract or binding checks. Reconcile the original operation.
errors.PUBLISHER_MARKET_CAPABILITY: The market has not enabled idempotent uploads. Resume after the capability is opened.
errors.PUBLISHER_MARKET_CREDENTIAL: The publishing credential is missing, expired, revoked or lacks permission. Bind a valid token for the same identity in Market connections.
errors.PUBLISHER_MARKET_IDENTITY: The new credential belongs to a different user or developer. Replacement and recovery were denied.
errors.PUBLISHER_MARKET_KEYRING: The system credential store is unavailable or has no credential. Check Keychain / Secret Service, then bind the token in Market connections.
errors.PUBLISHER_MARKET_PENDING: The result is pending. The original operation and frozen package are retained. Resume reconciliation.
errors.PUBLISHER_MARKET_REJECTED: The market rejected the operation. Inspect the original operation and current version state.
errors.PUBLISHER_SUBMISSION_CHANGED: The entire market artifact set changed. Refresh and inspect every artifact before creating a new submission.
errors.PUBLISHER_SUBMISSION_STATE: The version cannot be submitted in its current state. Refresh it; only draft or rejected versions can be submitted.
errors.PUBLISHER_SUBMISSION_CAPABILITY: The market has not enabled submission and idempotent writes. Verify again after P07 is ready.
errors.PUBLISHER_EXECUTOR_PREPARATION_FAILED: Could not prepare the publishing tools. Check the development environment and retry.
errors.PUBLISHER_CONTAINER_UNAVAILABLE: The local Linux container engine is unavailable. Check the build environment.
errors.PUBLISHER_CONTAINER_START_FAILED: The container engine did not become ready. Open its desktop application and check again.
errors.PUBLISHER_CONTAINER_BUILD_FAILED: The Linux container build failed. Open the build log for details.
errors.PUBLISHER_EXECUTOR_BUSY: The publishing tools are handling another task. Wait for it to finish before reconnecting.
errors.PUBLISHER_EXECUTOR_UPDATE_REQUIRED: The publishing tools are out of date. Update the tools in your plugin development environment and reconnect.
errors.PUBLISHER_EXECUTOR_HOST_UPDATE_REQUIRED: The development server has yet to load the reconnect feature. Restart it and open this page again.

unconfirmedWrite: The previous write has an unconfirmed result. Inspect the existing plans and tasks before starting another operation.

market.correctAddressHelp: Save to switch to the new connection, then bind a publishing token.
market.emptyConnection: Add a target market, then bind a publishing token.

connectionHint.offline: Reconnect the local publisher to continue.
connectionHint.unbound: Bind a publishing token to upload packages.
connectionHint.expired: Bind a new publishing token to continue.
connectionHint.limited: Bind a publishing token with upload permission to continue.
connectionHint.blocked: The token is bound. This market does not currently accept package uploads.
connectionHint.ready: Uploading creates a private draft in the market.

market.connectionHelp: Add the market API and approved console for this plugin, then use Bind publishing token to authorize it.
market.name: Connection name
market.capabilityClosed: Upload is not ready. Check credentials and advertised market capabilities.
market.bindHelp: Create a publishing token in the market console, then bind it here.
market.bindSafety: The token is used only for this binding request and saved in the system credential store. It is never written to task records or logs.
market.uploadHelp: Upload the selected frozen Linux/amd64 ZIP to create a private market draft.
market.needBuild: Complete and select a frozen artifact in Builds first.
market.serverProcessing: Reconciling the market operation or waiting for server processing. Completed transfer does not prove acceptance.
market.cancel: Stop transfer and retain pending operation
market.pollPaused: Page status queries are paused. Background work and the original operation remain available.
market.confirmDescription: Check the target market and version before uploading.
market.confirmBoundary: This creates a private draft. It does not submit a review or publish publicly. Recovery retains the original operation ID.
market.attention: Upload {version} needs attention. Inspect the original operation.
market.existingTask: This frozen package already has an upload record. Select the original task below to inspect or resume it.
market.validationName: Enter a connection name of at most 200 characters.
market.noVersions: This market has no versions for this plugin.
market.waitForExecutor: Connect the publishing tool to check
market.tokenHelp: Grant this plugin the upload and submission permissions needed for your next action.

review.title: Prepare and submit for review
review.intro: Check the entire artifact set, complete publication details, then confirm market review submission.
review.collectionHelp: Select a version and refresh its market collection. Every attached platform artifact must participate.

sources.verified_snapshot: Verified version snapshot supplied by the market
sources.official_releases: Official version catalog supplied by the market

review.unavailable: This connection is not ready for review submission. The market must enable submission and idempotent writes.
review.scopeHelp: The credential needs publications:read and publications:submit. Upload permission does not grant submission permission.
review.existingTask: This version has an unresolved or unrejected submission. Reconcile the original task first.
review.receiptBoundary: The receipt confirms registration. Review decisions and public publication are separate market actions.
review.approvedPrivate: Approval does not imply public publication.
review.cancel: Stop request and retain pending operation
review.pollPaused: Local submission status queries are paused. The original operation remains available.
review.noHistory: This plugin has no market review history.
review.metadataHelp: Text follows market validation. License and minimum Core version must come from market-supplied options.
review.validationText: Use at least 10 characters and at most 10000 UTF-8 bytes, without NUL characters.
review.confirmHelp: Check the market, version, every artifact and normalized details.
review.confirmBoundary: This submits for review. It does not approve or publish publicly. Reconcile the original operation after connection loss.
review.validationMissing: Check required fields in both detail sections.
review.historyHelp: Read existing market applications without creating a new submission.
review.collectionStatusUnknown: Awaiting confirmation. Refresh the original application.

trace.title: HTTP request records
trace.boundary: These records identify HTTP attempts. A response does not establish submission, approval or publication.
trace.empty: No request records have been captured for this task.
trace.unconfirmed: This intent has no recorded completion. Reconcile the original operation.

setupNotConfiguredTitle: Pair the local publishing tool first
setupNotConfiguredDescription: The publishing tool is not connected. Start it for this source workspace, then configure the private connection settings for Nuxt development.

setupSteps.start: 1. Start the tool in the plugin source workspace
setupSteps.restart: 3. Restart the development server and connect

setupRestartDescription: Replace the workspace placeholder with its actual absolute path and save these settings in the private Nuxt environment configuration. Restart Nuxt, then return here to connect. Use the exact browser origin: localhost and 127.0.0.1 are different. Keep the tool running; restart it before reconnecting if its bootstrap session has already been used.
managedDescription: The development service prepares and connects the tools for this plugin automatically.
containerCheckHelp: Start Docker with a local container environment, then check again.
nativeBuildUnavailable: Direct builds are unavailable. Check the local Go and Node.js build tools.
containerStartsWithBuild: The build opens your configured Docker Desktop or OrbStack when needed.
containerMissing: Docker was not detected. Install Docker, then check again.
containerBuildHelp: The first build downloads the Linux toolchain and locked dependencies. Source files and system credentials stay on this computer.
containerBuildUnavailable: Prepare the container engine before building.
